text:
maria: Hey, I'm about to land a TF change that creates an interface VPC endpoint in acct-B for the logging service. Quick sanity check? It needs cross-account PrivateLink and we need to be careful about route table associations.
akash: Paste the TF snippet + which route table you're targeting (egress-apps vs egress-shared).
maria: egress-apps. snippet:
```
resource "aws_vpc_endpoint" "logging" {
  vpc_id = data.aws_vpc.app_vpc.id
  service_name = "com.amazonaws.vpce.us-west-2.vpce-svc-abc123" # acct-B
  subnet_ids = aws_subnet.egress_apps[*].id
  security_group_ids = [aws_security_group.vpce_sg.id]
}
```
sophie: Two quick notes: 1) cross-account interface endpoints require the service owner (acct-B) to accept/connect. 2) don't assoc the endpoint with private subnets that rely on NAT for internet egress — that'll break SNAT for existing flows.
maria: acct-B confirmed they won't auto-accept. Thinking of adding a `aws_vpc_endpoint_connection_accepter` resource in their account or leaving a manual step in the runbook.
akash: Also check `private_dns_enabled` — if set true it'll override public DNS for that service name and can cause split-horizon. Decide whether you want to override service-wide DNS.
maria: We don't want to override global DNS for other consumers. I'll keep `private_dns_enabled = false` and add a conditional Route53 private zone alias for the specific service domain if needed.
sophie: SG rules: make sure the endpoint SG allows 443 from k8s worker SGs (or the egress SG), not `0.0.0.0/0`. Suggest referencing `module.eks.worker_sg` in the rule.
maria: ack — will set `security_group_ids = [aws_security_group.vpce_sg.id]` and add an `aws_security_group_rule` that allows ingress from `module.eks.worker_sg.id`.
infra-bot: Deploy preview for branch `maria/privatelink-logging` finished: plan -> 3 to add, 1 to change. Link: https://ci.internal/runs/98765
akash: Can someone run `terraform plan -target=aws_vpc_endpoint.logging` in sandbox before we apply? Want to ensure no shared-route-table drift.
maria: running on sandbox-2 now, will paste plan shortly.
maria: plan output: adds aws_vpc_endpoint.logging, aws_security_group.vpce_sg, data.aws_route_tables lookup; modifies aws_subnet.egress_apps tags only. No route table associations in this plan. :+1:
sophie: If you're changing subnet tags, watch the subnet-reconciler. It may kick off replacements. Consider `lifecycle { ignore_changes = [tags] }` on subnet resources or use tag updates that reconciler understands.
maria: good catch — I'll add `lifecycle` block and a comment in the module explaining why.
akash: One last Q on creds: consumers need IAM to call the logging API — are pods using node creds or IRSA? We should prefer IRSA.
maria: IRSA. Updated the k8s manifest to mount env vars for `LOGGING_ROLE_ARN` and TF will create an `aws_iam_role` plus `aws_iam_role_policy_attachment` for `logging:PutEvents` in the module.
sophie: Nice. LGTM once you tidy the module docs and add the sandbox plan output to the PR. Ping me on the PR for a final review.
maria: will open the PR in a few mins and tag you. thanks!
